full_judgment: 8. However, the said Mr. Md. Shahabuddin filed Title Suit No. 202 of 2002 against the Imam Dockyards and Engineering Ltd. and the petitioner, praying for a declaration of title and the cancellation of Deed of Sale No. 202 of 2002. After hearing, the learned Judge dismissed the suit by the judgment and decree dated 30-4-2009. Thereafter, by suppressing the previous facts against the said Md. Shahabuddin, filed Title Suit No. 78 of 2013 in the court of the learned Joint District Judge, First Court, Dhaka for recovery of Khas Possession. The instant petitioner filed an application under section 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure for rejection of the plaint. The learned Judge, by the order dated 18-7-2018, allowed the application and dismissed the said suit on the ground of res judicata.
